name: Todo List
description: Workflowy-style hierarchical outliner. Single-tree architecture — no lists, every node is part of one tree. Nodes have text, description, instructions (markdown), and a chronological log. Toggle complete (cascades to descendants), collapse/expand, move subtrees, and search.
tagline: Hierarchical outliner with markdown, logs, and tree operations

screens.name: tree-view
screens.title: My Tasks
screens.description: Full hierarchical tree of todo nodes — collapsible/expandable.

screens.name: node-detail
screens.title: Node Detail
screens.description: Single node with instructions (markdown) and chronological log.

screens.name: node-form
screens.title: Add / Edit Node
screens.description: Form for creating or editing a todo node (text, description, instructions).

nodeId.description: Optional: the node to edit. Omit for add mode.

parentId.description: Optional: parent node to nest under. Omit for root-level.
